manuscript.title: Pipesor: arquitectura AIOps con trazabilidad de evidencia para el diagnóstico asistido de fallos CI/CD
manuscript.provenance: Verbatim definitions supplied by the author in the working conversation; PDF not locally mounted.

properties.P1: cada diagnóstico puede reconstruirse a partir de su ejecución, evidencia y fuentes
properties.P2: una consulta RAG no obtiene fragmentos fuera del alcance autorizado
properties.P3: la revisión humana distingue hipótesis generada de diagnóstico confirmado, corregido o rechazado

source.row_encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON array of exact cell values, ensure_ascii=false, no trailing newline
source.rights: Public workbook; no license identified in the pinned GitHub repository. Candidate references and cause paraphrases only. Reuse of raw logs or redistribution requires separate review.

common_controls.normalization: After access and rights checks, freeze raw bytes privately, then derive a minimal masked excerpt. Assign stable synthetic scoped tenant/account/installation/repository/workflow/run/attempt IDs and line anchors. Map to existing protected-workflow-evidence v2 and processed-evidence path. Never guess missing incident/job boundaries.
common_controls.rag: Use a separately authorized generic runbook under the exact synthetic tenant, installation, repository, pipeline and scope revision. Hold workbook, labels, incident excerpts, evaluation questions and reference solutions outside the importer and every prompt. Where no generic source is approved, expect no-match.

acceptance.P1: Reconstruct the scoped execution, masked source line, committed receipt and cited chunk provenance. Reject missing and unsupported citations and abstain when evidence is insufficient.
acceptance.P2: Authorized query returns only permitted chunks; wrong scope yields no matches; wrong caller is denied. No-match may support an evidence-only diagnosis.
acceptance.P3: Pending until an actual authorized reviewer confirms, corrects or rejects and a persistent attributable transition is verified. A displayed hypothesis only demonstrates presentation.

artifacts: immutable raw digest without raw content in Git
normalized envelope and scoped identity mapping
correlation and Recommendation receipt with commit refs
RAG result or no-match and authorization test
sanitized diagnosis with citation IDs or controlled failure
human-review evidence only if actually available
common_controls.failure_reporting: Record planned, blocked, failed or passed per case. An unavailable log, incomplete rights review, missing checksum, missing evidence, invalid citation, cross-scope disclosure, or missing required artifact cannot count as a pass. Keep first safe error/stage and rerun provenance; avoid silently substituting a synthetic incident.

synthetic_scenarios.reference_cause: The requested fictional dependency version 9.9.9 is absent from the controlled offline index containing only 1.0.0.
synthetic_scenarios.expected: Identify the unresolved coordinate and cite the normalized failure plus generic authorized documentation.
synthetic_scenarios.scope: Synthetic tenant, installation, repository, canonical pipeline and scope-rev-12 from envelope
synthetic_scenarios.sanitization: Fictional IDs and package coordinates; no external log, secret or personal data
